title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
**Job Description**

* Partner with business leaders on people initiatives to support the organization’s growth and sustainability.
* Collaborate with various HR and business teams to implement policies, processes, and problem-solve on people matters.
* Advise on workforce planning, identify and address talent gaps, and develop strategies to meet the business needs through recruitment, talent development, and succession planning.
* Lead performance management initiatives and work with reporting managers in improving employee productivity and addressing performance gaps.
* Work with different levels of employees to solve conflicts and help facilitate positive employee relations, maintain a good working environment, build morale, and manage unwanted attrition.
* Lead change management efforts to ensure seamless transitions on organizational changes.
* Conduct offsite visits as needed.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Human Resources, Psychology, or Business Management.
* With at least 4-5 years experience in general HR and/or HR business partnering; experience in handling employees in ecommerce/logistics/warehousing industries is an advantage.
* Expertise in organizational development and/or employee relations is an advantage.
* Detail-oriented and has excellent organizational skills.
* Experience in project management and corresponding change management.
* Strong mindset for continuous improvement and exceeding client expectations.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
